strings.ato:ui.info: Analyzes this avatar's meshes, materials, animations and animations-driven state at build time; deduplicates textures, quality-scales UV islands and repacks them into type-grouped atlases. Runs during NDMF build (after Modular Avatar, before AAO). Generated textures go to Assets/AvatarTextureOptimizer-Generated.
strings.ato:ui.advanced.readonly: Thresholds are read-only for presets. Switch to Custom to edit them (starts at lossless).
strings.ato:ui.atlas.generate.tip: When off, textures are only scaled as a whole (UVs untouched)
strings.ato:ui.atlas.padding.tip: Actual padding = max(this, ceil(atlasMaxEdge/128)), clamped to >=4px
strings.ato:ui.atlas.npot.tip: Allow NPOT atlas candidates in 64px steps; platform-incompatible formats are filtered automatically
strings.ato:ui.dedup.textures.tip: Identical content + import settings collapse into one texture; references are updated
strings.ato:ui.dedup.materials.tip: Identical materials collapse; duplicate opaque slots merge when provably safe
strings.ato:ui.rule.mipstream.tip: Both bound together, as VRChat requires
strings.ato:ui.whitelist.tip: Any object type: GameObject, Renderer, Material, Texture2D, AnimationClip... Every texture referenced within is excluded from all optimization.
strings.ato:ui.verbose.tip: Print [ATO] details for every pipeline step to the console
